sin.name: boundary-duplicated-operation
sin.description: The same domain operation hand-rolled at two DIFFERENT entry boundaries (a console command and an MCP tool, a controller and a command) — one operation with two implementations that drift
sin.rule: One operation, one implementation. A boundary translates its own protocol and calls the shared application service; it does not re-spell the operation.
sin.suggestion: Hoist the shared sequence into one application service and have both faces call it.
